kernel.initial_fit: one class-owned MiniBatchKMeans fit using the supplied fold recipe
kernel.margin_selection: row-tiled ranking-equivalent float32 centroid scores; nearest correct and nearest wrong-class prototype
kernel.margin_accumulation: gather only selected prototypes and accumulate float64 per-feature margin/residual vectors
kernel.lloyd_update: one class-local weighted assignment and arithmetic centroid update
kernel.heldout_scoring: row-tiled strict current OI second-own versus best-target events

synthetic_regression.source: frozen diagonal_metric_toy generator and downstream references
synthetic_regression.purpose: regression check that tiling preserves the previously observed one-update ranking benefit; no tuning or promotion

timing_anchor.warmup: one excluded call per method and cell
timing_anchor.primary_clock: outer method-required normalization plus fit plus heldout score
timing_anchor.interpretation: timing and finite-score anchor only; no ranking or promotion claim
